title: App crashes after login
description: After entering a valid password, the app closes immediately. The log shows NullPointerException in SessionManager.

title: Crash on sign in
description: The client exits right after successful sign in. Stack trace mentions SessionManager and a missing session token.

title: Login button has wrong color
description: The login button is blue, but the design spec says it should be green.

title: CSV export times out
description: Exporting a large CSV report hangs for more than five minutes and eventually returns gateway timeout.

title: Report download timeout
description: When downloading a large CSV export, the request times out after several minutes.

title: Password reset email typo
description: The password reset email says recieve instead of receive.
